entry.title: A network update
entry.content:
SEEN welcomes the Civil Service policy for staff networks published recently. In light of the new editorial process that the policy sets out, SEEN is taking the proactive step of taking down our website’s blog content pending review in line with the new process.

We aim to post further updates here in due course.

•·················•·················•

Press release: Civil Service staff networks to only meet outside working hours and have all events signed off by senior managers (link)
